title: Print-path English sentences outside #37260: the /actions door's forward-unavailable 503 and the own-door bridge's 501 ignore the request locale
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnagJvGbCtNg2PhvgW

Filing gate ① — a defect with named locations. Source: the #37260 dev's out-of-scope findings (os-dev-report 7159457263 on #37260, PR #37272). The seat filed it as one follow-up in the same family (seat direction 7159533198).

## What happens

#37260 (PR #37272) localizes the print door's own 5xx sentences by `Accept-Language`, through the platform's operation-message catalog (`BUILTIN_OPERATION_MESSAGES` + `operationUserMessage`). Two more sentences on the print path stay hard-coded English in a non-English console:

1. **The `/actions` door's forward-unavailable 503.** `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts:2160`, `apiActionForwardUnavailableError(action, door)`, is relayed at `packages/runtime/src/action-dispatch.ts:754` as a `503` refusal. A print action (HotCRM `crm_quote.print_quote`) clicked while its forward target is unavailable shows this English sentence in a zh-CN console.
2. **The own-door bridge's 501.** `packages/runtime/src/domains/own-door-bridge.ts:162–181` answers `501` with English text when no service is registered for the slot ("… is not available: no … service is registered on this kernel. … registers it.") or when the registered service lacks the member. The print door uses it (`packages/runtime/src/domains/print.ts`).

Neither was reproduced in a browser by the #37260 dev; both were read from code on `main`.

## Expected

Both sentences follow the request locale the same way #37260's do: keys in the same operation-message catalog, in its full locale set (en, zh-CN, ja-JP, es-ES), with English byte-identical. Follow seat direction 7159533198: localize the wire `message`, and add no `userMessage` to a fault. Code and status are unchanged.

## Done when

- Under `accept-language: zh-CN`, each site answers in Chinese, with an English or absent-locale control that keeps today's text. One pin per site.
- An ablation that restores the hard-coded English turns each site's zh pin red.

## Also in scope (nits carried from PR #37272's reviews)

From the contract review 7160535636:
- The catalog header's `print_*` paragraph should say that a `translation` item's `errors.print_*` override is not consulted for these keys, because the door holds no i18n service.
- A throw with an empty message puts the localized sentence into the fault-log line; any other throw logs its own message. Say so, or keep the log line in English.
- `Accept-Language` is read by its top tag only (`preferredLocaleFromHeader`, no q-value negotiation), which is the platform's existing reading. Note it where these sentences are documented.

From the L1 7160466229 (wording and test, details in comment 7160569088): the zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES phrasing in N1–N3, and the `/srv/secret` assertion in N4.

Grade: area:ux · Bug · p2 (the same family as #37260 p1, on rarer paths: a forward that is unavailable and a kernel that lacks the print service). Size S.
Reader: zone a4-C of seat repo:objectstack#4, after PR #37272 merges, because it reuses the catalog keys and the helper that PR adds.
Blocked-by: #37272
Dedupe: `apiActionForwardUnavailableError` (open objectstack issues) → 1 hit, #37260 itself. `own-door bridge 501 locale` → 0.
